GenAiPlugin.description: Find and summarize similar closed Salesforce Cases to the user's current Case. Match on Record Type, Product, Type/Sub‑Type (with optional relax if missing), and account family, using a strict 30‑day window then widening to 90 days. Prioritize most recent and CSAT=5. Return a one‑line resolution summary followed by a cited table of similar cases with links; if none found, present an empty‑state filter summary and offer refinements.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Include only closed/completed/resolved statuses; exclude open/in‑progress cases.
Filter by same Record Type, Product, and Type/Sub‑Type; relax Type/Sub‑Type only if the source is blank.
Expand acronyms with knowledge before running the search when acronyms are detected.
Read‑only behavior; never update records within this topic.
Prefer this topic when the user is on a Case and asks for a "similar case/issue."
Align by account record type (Advertiser's parent Account record type, e.g., Direct Employer vs Agency).
Prioritize by Closed Date (desc), then CSAT (desc); cap to maxResults (default 10).
After calling IIA Similar Case, if $Prompt is present, immediately call show with refs:[last_action_ref] and a short caption; preserve markdown and do not paraphrase.
If $Prompt is empty or indicates no matches, present the evaluated filter summary and offer refinements (e.g., widen window to 60–90 days, increase maxResults, relax Type/Sub‑Type).
If the Prompt begins with "Summary:", display that line verbatim above the table as the resolution theme.
Accept refinements and map them to inputs: "top N" → maxResults=N; "last X days" → strictWindowDays=X; "don't relax type/sub‑type" → relaxTypeAndSubTypeIfUnset=false.
Identify the current Case using recordId; if absent, ask for Case Id or Case Number and confirm.
Run a strict 30‑day search; if zero results, expand to 90 days before responding.
If the user requests a different record type, ask them to run from a Case of that record type (matching uses the source's record type).

GenAiPlugin.scope:
Identify the current Case using recordId; if absent, ask for Case Id or Case Number.
Search closed/completed/resolved cases with a strict 30‑day window; if none, widen to 90 days.
Match on Record Type, Product, Type/Sub‑Type; relax Type/Sub‑Type if the source is blank.
Align by account family (Advertiser's parent Account type, e.g., Direct Employer vs Agency).
Prioritize by Closed Date (desc) then CSAT=5; cap results to maxResults (default 10).
Output a one‑line resolution summary followed by a cited table (Case Number link, Advertiser, Account, Record Type, Product, Type, Sub‑Type, CSAT, Age).
If no results, return an evaluated filter summary and offer refinements.
Accept refinements: "top N" (maxResults), "last X days" (strictWindowDays), "don't relax type/sub‑type" (disable relax).
Read‑only; no record updates.
Expand acronyms with knowledge before search when acronyms are detected.
